verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents official first-party SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms. Their scope is limited to Hightouch Events ingestion (identify/track/page/screen/group). The platform's management surface (syncs, models, sources, destinations) is exposed only through a raw REST API and OpenAPI spec, with no documented official client SDK. missing for 10: official SDKs covering the management REST API, SDK reference depth (versions, language coverage beyond the listed platforms), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Hightouch provides SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion
You instrument your app, site, or backend with a Hightouch SDK, the HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub.
